==> caddy/sites/pingvin-share-x.caddy
# Generated by Roostack for service "pingvin-share-x". Do not edit: changes will be overwritten.

@pingvin-share-x-web host share.lab.example.com
handle @pingvin-share-x-web {
	vars {
		roostack_name pingvin-share-x
		roostack_title "Pingvin Share X"
		roostack_private yes
	}
	@pingvin-share-x-web-external not {
		remote_ip private_ranges 100.64.0.0/12 100.80.0.0/16 100.82.0.0/15 100.84.0.0/14 100.88.0.0/13 100.96.128.0/17 100.97.0.0/16 100.98.0.0/15 100.104.0.0/13 100.112.0.0/12
		not vars roostack_edge yes
	}
	abort @pingvin-share-x-web-external
	request_body {
		max_size 10GB
	}
	request_header -Remote-User
	request_header -Remote-Email
	request_header -Remote-Name
	request_header -Remote-Groups
	reverse_proxy 169.254.1.3:20010
}
